name: Middleburg and Keystone Heights
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Middleburg, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Middleburg and Keystone Heights, FL: Omega Park parade, Kiwanis parade, Christmas Market, library Santa and the Oakleaf parade.
lede: Middleburg and Keystone Heights do Christmas with small-town parades on the second Saturday in December, a Santa visit at the library and a lakeside Christmas Market.
celebrates: Middleburg and Keystone Heights celebrate with hometown parades and markets. On Saturday, December 12, the Middleburg Christmas Parade and Festival fills Omega Park with vendors from 2 pm and sends floats down County Road 218 in the evening, and Santa visits the Middleburg-Clay Hill Library in the morning. The same day in Keystone Heights, the City and Clay County Tourism host the Christmas Market at the Theme Park with live music, reindeer games for kids and a dog costume contest, and the Lake Region Kiwanis Club runs the evening parade on Lawrence Boulevard. A week earlier, Oakleaf holds its own parade.
lastyear: In 2025 Keystone Heights held its Second Annual Christmas Market on December 13 from 10 am to 4 pm at the Historic Pavilion at Lake Geneva, with crafts, food trucks and local vendors, according to Explore Clay. The Middleburg-Clay Hill Library hosted a Santa visit on December 13, 2025, from 11 am to 2 pm. The 2024 Middleburg Parade and Festival ran December 14 from 6:30 to 9 pm at the Clay County Outdoor Adventure Park, hosted by the Clay County Business Association and the Middleburg Civic Association.
facts: Keystone Heights is a small lake town in western Clay County, and Explore Clay says its Kiwanis parade has more than 50 festive floats. This year's market is the third annual. Middleburg's parade has moved around: it was at the Clay County Outdoor Adventure Park in 2024, and this year the organizers say they are bringing it back to County Road 218, with a festival at Omega Park.
trains: None of the 2026 listings in Middleburg or Keystone Heights is a train ride. For a train day, families go to Jacksonville, and our Jacksonville Terminal page is the closest railroad entry on the site. ClayFLNews also lists free hay and train rides at Hometown Holiday in the Park in Orange Park on December 12, though the town's own page mentions hay rides.
train_links: The closest train museum page on our site, in Jacksonville.
traditions: An evening parade on County Road 218 with a festival at Omega Park.
More than 50 floats on Lawrence Boulevard in Keystone Heights.
Vendors, food trucks, live music and reindeer games at the Theme Park.
A dog costume contest from 10 to 11 am at the Keystone Heights market.
The Middleburg-Clay Hill Library hosts Santa for photos.
Floats, Santa and food trucks, from Trinity Baptist Church to Oakleaf High School.
kidfact: At the Keystone Heights Christmas Market, kids can play reindeer games, and dogs can enter the Santa Paws costume contest.
faq: When is the Middleburg Christmas Parade in 2026?
Saturday, December 12, 2026. Vendors open at Omega Park at 2 pm and the parade rolls along County Road 218 in the evening, at about 6:30 pm according to the organizers' posts.
When is the Keystone Heights Christmas Parade?
The Lake Region Kiwanis Club parade is Saturday, December 12, 2026, at 6 pm on Lawrence Boulevard. The Christmas Market at the Theme Park runs from 10 am to 4 pm the same day.
Where can kids meet Santa in Middleburg?
Santa visits the Middleburg-Clay Hill Library, 2245 Aster Ave, on Saturday, December 12, from 10 am to 1 pm. The library page does not print a price.
Is there a Christmas parade in Oakleaf?
Yes. The 4th Annual Oakleaf Christmas Parade is Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 6:30 pm, from Trinity Baptist Church to Oakleaf High School, with vendors from 4 pm.
Are there Christmas events in Penney Farms or Lawtey?
We found no public 2026 Christmas event posted for Penney Farms or Lawtey on the hosts' pages.

intro_html:

We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
